events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic voice and stage presence of Freddie Mercury, who would have turned 80 today. What’s your favourite Queen track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead vocalist and songwriter Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her influence on rock is undeniable. What’s your go-to Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it, Liam!
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released 55 years ago in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine... 55 years on
angles.copy: It's 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was unveiled 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket full of tunes
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, what's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The iconic musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the profound legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: No silly walks here, just cake!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's a true comedic genius. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their incredible range. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Forever a champion
angles.copy: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true legend. His voice and spirit live on. What's the Queen song that always moves you?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On the 46th anniversary of his passing, we reflect on the enduring impact of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.
